system.notes:
Badgerlings are elite warrior-halflings who model their combat style upon the vicious, burrow-dwelling badger. They wear badgerskin cloaks and attack from ambush before fading away again to set up a new surprise assault. Badgerlings are both feared and respected by their fellow halflings. Badgerling warbands only follow halfling commanders (see Warband rules in Game Master’s Guide to the Western Reaches). A wild-eyed halfling wearing a badger skin cloak and wielding a sharply honed axe in each hand.

AC 13 (leather), HP 9, ATK 1 handaxe (close/near) +2 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +2, C +0, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL N, LV 2

Ambush. Deal an extra die of damage when undetected.

Invisibility. Once per day, turn invisible for 3 rounds. Attacking ends the invisibility.

Art by Yuri Perkowski Domingos, 2023
